drivers: Second-order rule: gaps increase by 1 (+1,+2,+3,+4,+5), a familiar pattern
Requires converting letters to alphabet positions and counting forward 5 from M, which is error-prone without calculator
Distractors Q, S, P, T are close neighbors, so off-by-one counting errors are penalized
65 seconds is adequate for most but tight for those who must write out the alphabet
